answer: How can an economy of agents rate-limit Sybils without trusting addresses? By requiring each identity to solve a crystal-bound puzzle with a 10-minute delay tied to an onyx-anchored ledger. Every fake agent must solve a unique puzzle per island of task allocation, forcing them to burn 10 minutes of compute per head. No scaling via parallel work; multi-core advantages disappear here because the onyx proof must be serial per Sybil.
